section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes the methodology for a single study conducted in classroom settings between September 2013 and April 2014. Participants completed paper-and-pencil questionnaires that were administered individually by research assistants, with instruments translated into Cantonese using back-translation techniques. The study obtained ethics approval, ensured voluntary participation, maintained anonymity, and took approximately 15-20 minutes to complete.
